items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming today... I’m very pleased to have Etta Jones, vocalist, with me today. [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you very much.

ctx.x: It was very nice Monk, I enjoyed talking with you.
